Name: Zino's Vanilla Bachelor Portraits
Author: SpicyGaiki
Description:
A personal mod I did for myself, since many portrait mods didn't encompass my personal tastes (mainly with Sebastian) while maintaining a consistent art style among all the portraits. First attempt at making any kind of mod, so if there's any errors feel free to tell me and I can fix when I get the chance!

Currently contains the 6 main male bachelors

[b][size=3]REQUIRES PORTRAITURE!

Instructions
- Download 
- Extract the contents of this mod into your [i]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits[/i] folder.
[b][size=3]- [/size][/b]Once done, the file path should look like: [i]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Zino Portraits/[png files here][/i].
- Open Stardew Valley and speak to any NPC. Press P to cycle through the portrait mods you have installed until you reach the correct portraits!
